name: Shanghai Bloom Technology, Inc.
summary: Shanghai Bloom Technology, Inc. specializes in delivering comprehensive system solutions for the management of powdered and granular materials. Its expertise spans pneumatic conveyance, precise metering and mixing, secure storage, thorough blending, and homogenization of these substances. Additionally, the company provides corresponding components, replacement parts, and related support services. Established on November 19, 2001, its principal office is located in Shanghai, China.
